in_marathi.name: Ajmat
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ajmat हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ajmat is a Sanskrit name derived from the root 'ajas' which means 'invincible' or 'unconquered'. This name signifies strength, power, and courage. In Hindu mythology, Ajmat is the name of a warrior god, symbolizing bravery and fearlessness.
